description:
[read-only] Scheduled check-ins for one campaign (default day 3, 7 and 14 after activation): whether they are on, the Embers price of each, and every past check-in with its spend, findings and charge. Charges nothing.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/ads/campaigns/{id}/checkpoints.)

brandId.description: A brand id (GET /api/v2/brands) or "personal"; default: the key owner's active brand.

name: ads_checkpoints_get
title: Read campaign check-ins
